content.text: What is the architecture of the mcp_server module?

content: Let me read the file first.

The mcp_server module uses FastMCP to expose 7 tools: search, get_node, neighbors, temporal_query, context, propose_change, review_note. The server reads facts.jsonl via GraphStore and applies namespace permissions through ScopedGraph.

content.text: How does the journal system work?

content: Agent-proposed facts append to pending/<ns>/journal.jsonl as append-only JSONL. The resolve pass merges them into facts.jsonl, gating by confidence.
The journal uses an append-only model. Each entry has a status (pending, accepted, rejected). Resolve merges accepted entries.
